verdict.rationale: Slack documents an official Slack CLI for creating and managing Slack apps from the command line, with commands such as `slack create` and a quickstart built around it, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page. The documented scope is app development, though, not general workspace operations, and nothing shows agent-oriented design. Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI features (machine-readable output, non-interactive use), CLI coverage of workspace actions beyond app management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Slack command-line interface (CLI) allows you to create and manage Slack apps from the command line.
Download the command-line tool for developing Slack apps.
This quickstart guide covers how to create a Slack app using the Slack CLI and the Bolt frameworks, in either Python or JavaScript.
